Resource points read 5 (Stitch 5, Refresh 5, Train 5) as expected. I logged F019, F023, F024 and F025: two praise, two low ux. The ux ones are that the I-VI strip shows no done ticks, and that my proposal to Ada was confirmed at once without explanation. No console errors. I said at the table that I am done, and updated memory.
